body_excerpt:
ASUS has released important security updates for ASUS System Control Interface, the service used by the MyASUS app, and for ASUS Business Manager. This update applies to all personal computers, including desktops, laptops, NUCs, and All-in-One PCs.
This update addresses security vulnerabilities related to improper access control within specific driver components of these products. If exploited, the issues could allow a local administrator to bypass intended security restrictions, potentially impacting system integrity.
ASUS strongly recommends that users update to the latest version immediately. 
For ASUS System Control Interface, the update can be received via the MyASUS app (with an internet connection), the ASUS Support website, or Windows Update. For ASUS Business Manager, the update can be received via the MyASUS app or the ASUS Support website.
